text:
Elaine: @here Quick sync — we need to coordinate a header rename for signed requests that affects marketplace sellers and SI integrations. Proposal: change X-Redwood-Signature -> X-Rdw-Sig, but accept both for a transition window. Thoughts?
Matt: +1 on dual-accept. Can we define a clear timeline (notify, dual-accept window, final cut)? Partners will want at least 60-90 days.
Sanjay: Eng perspective: we can support both headers for 90 days with a rollout toggle on the gateway. We'll emit a deprecation log when the old header is used. Need to confirm perf impact (should be negligible).
Ana: I'll own partner comms and marketplace notice. Draft plan: initial heads-up (today), docs + migration guide (2 weeks), marketplace banner + direct emails (30 days), final cut (90 days). Will we provide a sample library patch?
Paul: Security note: ensure canonicalization and HMAC inputs stay identical. If header name changes but MAC message changes, we'll break signatures. Sanity check: code sample for canonical string below.
Paul: ```
const toSign = `${method}
${path}
${timestamp}`; // same order as today
const sig = hmac(secret, toSign);
// header names don't change HMAC input
```
Sanjay: Confirmed — gateway will compute HMAC from request payload + canonical string unchanged, just look for either header for verification.
Elaine: Great. Logistics: Ana will send the partners list; Matt to approve public docs; Sanjay to add feature flag + logs; Paul to review security blurb. Who owns marketplace banner?
Ana: I'll coordinate with marketplace PMs. ETA to get banner running: ~10 business days after docs are live.
Matt: Can we add an experimental header-alias env var for partner sandboxes, so partners can test before prod switch?
Sanjay: Yes, we'll add RDW_SIG_ALIAS env var for sandboxes and a small integration test that fails if both headers missing.
Elaine: Deploy bot, please schedule a canary config for dual-header acceptance on staging at 2026-04-06 14:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging gateway config update (dual-header) on 2026-04-06 14:00 UTC. Canary to 10% traffic for 2h, auto-rollback on 5xx spike.
Ana: I'll draft partner email copy and a checklist: how to enable alias in test, update SDK snippet, verify signatures, opt into market banner preview. Will share draft by EOD Friday.
Paul: Also recommend adding a telemetry metric 'signature_header' with values 'old'|'new' so we can report adoption weekly.
Sanjay: Adding metric + deprecation warning log. We'll push PRs to sdk-examples with snippet diff.
Matt: Approving timeline: notify today, docs in 2w, marketplace + direct emails at 30d, final cut at 90d. If telemetry shows <80% adoption at 85d, we delay final cut by 30d.
Elaine: Ops: capture action items and owners here. I'll pull this into the partner runbook and send to legal for messaging signoff. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Ana: tagging partner contacts list now.
Paul: passing to security review.
Sanjay: PRs queued, will link here when ready.
Elaine: Closing loop — we'll reconvene in this thread for any partner escalations.
